concerns: Input has no artist; the agent resolved the artist from the id 'spatzen-mc-titleonly' (not in the input), which is an assumption; the result nonetheless matches the title and MC format.

Result claims 'Sarner-Welle Lied' with a single hyphen vs J-Card back showing 'Sarner-Welle-Lied' (tl-vision 30 read two hyphens); the chosen spelling is an unresolved variant, though a spelling-level issue only.

Result claims A1 duration 202 s and A6 210 s as printed; the J-Card front read (tl-vision #28) shows 3'22'' and 3'30'', supporting them. The Discogs entry 2297987 printed-in-notes durations were not read directly from the MC image; the statement 'von Discogs bestätigt' for A1 is supported by Discogs 3:22.
Result states the country as AT and label 'Koch-Records Special' while Discogs lists 'Koch Records Special' and 'Koch Records' — minor, consistent.
Result reports 'Titel Track B4' conflict resolution citing MB and Discogs 'Sarner-Welle Lied', which matches tool output.
Result's confidence 0.8 is reasonable given the agreement of printed durations with Discogs/Deezer, though MB A1 3:19 and A6 Discogs 3:03 were explained as outliers.
